meta.update_2026_10_28: Added 4 books from the 28 Oct update: hammock, gong (shelf row 16, locked until player level 72), curtain, quilt (shelf row 15, locked until player level 58). Overview showed 0/5 for each. Row 14 (Lvl 57) unchanged: clock 0/2, marimba 0/5, katana 0/2 (matches existing). Upgrade costs partly cut off on the screenshots (7/13,500 hammock/gong, 7/12,300 curtain/quilt, leading digits not visible): NOT recorded.

news_popup_2026_10_28.note: News bulletin figures are NOT authoritative: Jo (12:12) says the update went live today and the screenshots of the actual game data are more accurate than the bulletin. Library shelf locks from the screenshots (58 quilt/curtain, 72 hammock/gong) stay as the recorded values. Jo's view (user_stated, not tested): the difference between the two is probably down to which player level you are on in the game. Bulletin unlock levels kept only as a reference. Also in the news: Bigger Production Stacks, Load All button for ship/plane crates, Platinum League.

developer_email_2026_10_28.source: Email from Sunshine Island (Stillfront Germany), 'Fresh recipes & a little surprise inside', Wed 28 Oct 2026 11:13 AM, PDF supplied by Jo 14:43
developer_email_2026_10_28.authority: developers' own email; Jo (user_stated 14:43) says the levels should be correct for the new updates
developer_email_2026_10_28.notes: The email says the 'Level' for each recipe. The email gives the two ingredients but not the quantities (quantities come from the screenshots). Same five unlock levels as the news popup. The Library shelf locks seen earlier (curtain 58, gong and hammock 72) differ from these levels, so Library levels are probably not the same as these levels (UNCONFIRMED). The email also teases 'more on the way' and a subscribers-only 'sneak peek' that is just a picture of a teddy bear with no building, recipe or level.
developer_email_2026_10_28.jo_explanation_14_46: user_stated 14:46: Jo reads the difference as the Library having its own shelves that unlock at certain levels, separate from the level at which a recipe unlocks. Plausible and consistent with the data (Library shelf locks curtain/quilt 58, gong/hammock 72 versus recipe levels 58/67/72/90) but NOT tested.
